title: Catalog pricing hero + deprecation asset set for release notes and quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a cohesive set of UX assets and product screenshots for the upcoming public release notes and quickstart tutorial. Assets include: 1) Hero banner variations showing new model entries and updated pricing tiers; 2) Deprecation badges and modal screenshots for models slated for sunset; 3) Compact pricing matrix for embedding vs chat vs reranking; 4) Annotated quickstart screenshots that map UI elements to steps in the docs. Deliverables should be ready for web (2x PNG), email (600px banner), and Figma component library (SVGs + variants).
acceptance_criteria: Hero banner variants (3 sizes) exported at 2x and 1x and approved in Figma
Deprecation modal and inline badge styles implemented and accessibility-checked (AA color contrast)
Pricing matrix screenshot shows token and per-request columns for chat/embeddings/rerank, with unit labels matching release docs
Quickstart annotated images include callouts for: model selection, pricing estimator, and rollout controls
All assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the release notes PR before publish date
